{"props":{"pageProps":{"slug":"index","content":" # IPinfo Developer Resource
The quickest and easiest way to get started with IPinfo is to use one of our [official libraries](/developers/libraries), which are available for many popular programming languages and frameworks. If you'd like to write your own library or interact directly with our API, then the documentation below can help you. ![IPinfo Quickstat](https://website-cdn.assets.ipinfo.io/images/developers/ipinfo_quickstart.png) ## Authentication Your [API token](/dashboard/token) is used to authenticate you with our API. The IPinfo API endpoint supports authentication using any of the following methods: - A `token` query parameter (`?token=$TOKEN`) - HTTP Basic Authentication (using the token as the username, e.g. `curl -u $TOKEN:`) - A Bearer token in the Authorization header (`Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN`) You can find your IPinfo API access token on your [dashboard](/dashboard/token). ![IPinfo Access Token](https://website-cdn.assets.ipinfo.io/images/developers/ipinfo_api_access_token.png) [IPinfo Lite](/developers/lite-api) is our free tier API service available to all users. The API returns country and ASN information without any API request quota restrictions. > IPinfo Lite uses the **`api.ipinfo.io`** API URL and **`/lite`** endpoint. ```bash # With token query parameter $ curl https://api.ipinfo.io/lite/me?token=$TOKEN $ curl https://api.ipinfo.io/lite/8.8.8.8?token=$TOKEN # With Basic Auth $ curl -u $TOKEN: https://api.ipinfo.io/lite/me $ curl -u $TOKEN: https://api.ipinfo.io/lite/8.8.8.8 # With Bearer token $ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.ipinfo.io/lite/me $ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.ipinfo.io/lite/8.8.8.8 ```
